scope: Development comparison of orchestration strategies around the SAME E156 replay verifier; not a ranking of independent scientific engines.
interruption: Exit the first Python process after the audit checkpoint, then resume in a fresh Python process. Not a mid-write crash or power-loss durability test.
workflow: audit -> emit local receipt; emit never publishes externally or establishes release readiness
integrity_contract: Unchanged bundles complete with the anchored payload. Changed source or result bytes must refuse before emitting a current verified receipt.
selection: Two existing OA development bundles already used to build the replay checker. No tuning or held-out generalization claim. Naive cached orchestration is an intentionally incomplete integration control, not a LangGraph vulnerability.
environment: Windows, CPython 3.13; LangGraph 1.2.20 with SQLite checkpointer 3.1.3. No API credentials, private corpora, model responses or network calls during evaluation.
